text.text_excerpt: Fucking love this place. To be honest I never knew a lot about beer and never really drank a lot of beer. But when this place opened by my house I came here once to get a 6 pack of a stout and found out that they have beer on draft and you can actually chill here and play games, which is great! I have learned so much from just coming here and talking with the employees. What I really love is that they don't make you feel stupid for not knowing a lot about beer. They really enjoy educating people and making sure we are getting something that we will like. The employees are all soooo nice and welcoming to everyone. All I can say is that they have changed my perception of beer and have turne...

I'm just going to start off by saying this place is awesome! The craft beer selection is insane and you can mix & match everything on the shelves. You can either use can holders or 4/6 pack beer holders to hold the beers you want to try out. There are some beers in the cooler, on the shelves, or behind the counter! You know what? There's just beer everywhere in this store! The staff is really friendly and will help you with anything you may need. There are rotating draft beers on tap, if you wanted to hang out and relax. They have a couple of corn hole boards, couches, and restrooms for customers. All in all, it really is a cool place to hang out. I have been here a few times and it has a...

Great craft beer selection with friendly knowledgeable staff. They have some beers on tap for you to try out at the bar. Pull up a seat and enjoy. The interior is fantastic. It's not just a store, it's a community hang out spot. They have a great selection, and working to bring back craft beer to New Orleans. The history of craft beer in NOLA is fascinating. The good news is that it's definitely making a strong come back in just the past couple of years. There is ample free parking available as well. The building looks more like a bank then a store.
